Su di te

La strategia “Forever Chocolate” di Barry Callebaut include forti impegni nei confronti dei cambiamenti climatici e della protezione forestale. Obiettivi corresponsabili sono stati specificamente formalizzati per riflettere l’ambizione di Barry Callebaut di prevenire la deforestazione nelle catene di approvvigionamento delle materie prime del Gruppo e ridurre le emissioni di carbonio:

• Entro il 2025, per essere foresta positiva

• Entro il 2030, avremo decarbonizzato la nostra impronta in linea con gli sforzi globali per catturare il riscaldamento globale a 1,5 gradi Celsius

• Entro il 2050, saremo una società di net-zero

La strategia di Barry Callebaut per raggiungere i predetti obiettivi “Forest Positive” e rispettare il prossimo Regolamento Europeo sulla Deforestazione (EUDR) comprende una serie di strumenti per adempiere agli obblighi di diligenza dovuti a BC, così come gli obiettivi di Protezione Forestale. Questi strumenti e programmi consentiranno al Gruppo di rivendicare volumi importati in Europa dal 2025 in poi sono “senza disboscamento” e conformi a EUDR. Questo ruolo assicura che Barry Callebaut ha il monitoraggio della deforestazione migliore in classe e le capacità di intelligenza del rischio geospaziale per supportare la gestione del rischio conforme, privo di deforestazione e legale così come la gestione del rischio proattivo. Nell'ambito di questo quadro, il Forest Risk & Monitoring Manager supervisionerà la governance, le prestazioni e il miglioramento continuo degli strumenti e delle procedure di monitoraggio della deforestazione.

Le responsabilità chiave includono

• Deforestazione agricola e legalità Due Diligence:

• Proprio e costantemente ottimizzare il modello operativo e i processi di due diligence a livello aziendale, tra cui il monitoraggio della deforestazione e la gestione del sistema di allerta, sia le verifiche sul campo e le valutazioni di legalità contro aree protette (PA)

• Gestisci i rapporti con i fornitori di servizi selezionati per la valutazione del rischio di deforestazione, la verifica della legalità e il monitoraggio continuo

• Superare e mantenere la governance globale e le SOP locali, tra cui ruoli chiari e responsabilità per il monitoraggio della deforestazione e valutazioni di legalità

• Liaise con i team Digital, traceability e MEL per garantire un’integrazione senza soluzione di continuità e flussi di dati tra la piattaforma di deforestazione e monitoraggio della legalità di BC e gli strumenti di raccolta dati pertinenti

• Migliorare metodologie e sistemi per identificare aree di deforestazione ad alto rischio, fornire raccomandazioni proattive per sourcing team e implementare azioni di mitigazione necessarie

• Innovazione e miglioramento continuo:

• Monitorare gli sviluppi del mercato in analisi geospaziali, monitoraggio satellitare e modellazione dei rischi di deforestazione

• Valutare nuovi strumenti, metodologie e fonti di dati per migliorare le soluzioni attuali

• Identificare e sostenere attivamente la creazione e lo sviluppo di innovazioni, tra cui tecniche, strumenti e processi per migliorare l'efficienza, l'accuratezza e il valore aziendale globale

• Mantenere e crescere una rete esterna (ad esempio fornitori, ONG, piattaforme, start-up)

• Analisi dei dati e informazioni aziendali:

• Fornire assistenza tecnica e garantire una condivisione accurata dei dati tra i team, rafforzare la conoscenza interna, le capacità e le implementazioni di azione.

• Co-design e implementa con MEL (Monitoring, Evaluation e Learning) un'agenda di valutazione geospaziale che si adatta alle esigenze del team Thriving nature, inclusi i dati di deforestazione e di utilizzo del terreno per identificare tendenze, rischi e intuizioni attuabili

• Tradurre i dati geospaziali in raccomandazioni chiare e attuabili per i team di sourcing e sostenibilità

• Liaise con i team Digital, MEL e Traceability sulle necessità di raccolta e gestione dei dati per supportare la gestione dei rischi proattiva individuando aree, modelli e minacce emergenti ad alto rischio

• Attuazione della strategia & Stakeholder

• Allenamento, adozione e implementazione standardizzata di metodologie, strumenti e processi in team e geografie

• Monitorare le prestazioni e garantire l'allineamento con le roadmap strategiche, conducendo iniziative di miglioramento continuo in team globali e locali per soddisfare le priorità aziendali (ad esempio, conformità EUDR, rilevamento dei rischi, decisioni di assistenza)

About you

Barry Callebaut’s “Forever Chocolate” strategy includes strong commitments towards climate change and forest protection. Corresponding objectives have specifically been formalized to reflect Barry Callebaut’s ambition to prevent deforestation in the Group’s raw materials’ supply chains and reduce carbon emissions:

• By 2025, to be forest positive

• By 2030, we will have decarbonized our footprint in line with global efforts to cap global warming at 1.5 degrees Celsius

• By 2050, we will be a net-zero company

Barry Callebaut’s strategy to reach the aforementioned “Forest Positive” targets and comply with upcoming European Union Deforestation Regulation (EUDR) encompasses a set of tools to carry out BC’s due diligence obligations, as well as Forest Protection objectives. These tools and programs will enable the Group to claim volumes imported in Europe from 2025 onwards are “deforestation-free” and EUDR compliant. This role ensures that Barry Callebaut has best-in-class deforestation monitoring and geospatial risk intelligence capabilities to support compliant, deforestation-free and legal sourcing as well as proactive risk management. Within this framework, the Forest Risk & Monitoring Manager will oversee the governance, performance and continuous improvement of deforestation monitoring tools and procedures.

Key Responsibilities include

• Farm Deforestation and Legality Due Diligence:

• Own and continuously optimize the operating model and processes for farm-level due diligence, including deforestation monitoring and alert system management, both deskbased and field verifications as well as legality assessments against Protected Areas (PAs)

• Manage relationships with selected service provider(s) for deforestation risk assessment, legality verification and ongoing monitoring

• Oversee and maintain global governance and local SOPs including clear roles and responsibilities for deforestation monitoring and legality assessments

• Liaise with Digital, traceability and MEL teams to ensure seamless integration and data flows between BC’s deforestation and legality monitoring platform and relevant data collection tools

• Own and continuously improve methodologies and systems to identify high-risk deforestation areas, deliver proactive recommendations to sourcing teams, and implement necessary mitigation actions

• Innovation and Continuous Improvement:

• Monitor market developments in geospatial analytics, satellite monitoring, and deforestation risk modelling

• Evaluate new tools, methodologies, and data sources to enhance current solutions

• Proactively identify and support the creation and development of innovations, including techniques, tools, and processes to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and overall business value

• Maintain and grow an external network (e.g. providers, NGOs, platforms, start-ups)

• Data Analysis and Business Insights:

• Provide technical guidance and ensure accurate data sharing among teams, strengthening internal knowledge, capabilities and action implementations.

• Co-design and implement with MEL (Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning) a geospatial evaluation agenda that fits the needs of the Thriving nature team, including deforestation and land-use data to identify trends, risks, and actionable insights

• Translate geospatial data into clear, actionable recommendations for sourcing and sustainability teams

• Liaise with Digital, MEL and Traceability teams on data gathering and management needs to support proactive risk management by identifying high-risk areas, patterns, and emerging threats

• Strategy Implementation & Stakeholder Enablement:

• Act as the go-to expert on deforestation monitoring, providing guidance across teams and functions

• Support the development of dashboards, reporting frameworks, and decision-support tools to enable data-driven insights

• Drive training, adoption, and standardized implementation of methodologies, tools, and processes across teams and geographies

• Monitor performance and ensure alignment with strategic roadmaps, leading continuous improvement initiatives across global and local teams to meet business priorities (e.g., EUDR compliance, risk detection, sourcing decisions)

• 7-10+ years of experience on a similar role

• PhD or MSc degree in respective discipline

• Strong knowledge of GIS, remote sensing, and geospatial analysis tools

• Familiarity with data management (Databricks, SQL) is a plus

• Excellent English language skills. French and/or Spanish language skills are a plus

• Strong analytical mindset with experience in geospatial data processing and interpretation

• Proven ability to translate complex technical outputs into actionable business insights

• Experience managing external vendors, service providers, or geospatial technology partners

• Strong stakeholder management experience across technical and non-technical teams

• Proven track record in developing analytical tools, monitoring systems, or intelligence capabilities

• In-depth understanding of land-use change, deforestation dynamics, and associated risks

• Good understanding of EUDR and related regulatory frameworks

• Ability to influence stakeholders and gain buy-in across functions and seniority levels

• Ability to operate effectively in international and multicultural environments

• Ability to drive operations and strategies in large, complex, and remote teams without direct hierarchical authority

• Self-starter with a hands-on and proactive working style

• Thrives under pressure while maintaining high personal and professional integrityAbility to organize and prioritize work in a dynamic environment

• Positive “can-do” attitude and solution-oriented as well as practical mindset

• Creative, out-of-the-box thinker with strong problem-solving capabilities

• Flexible and adaptable in a fast-evolving and regulatory-driven environment

Über dich

Barry Callebauts „Forever Chocolate-Strategie beinhaltet ein starkes Engagement für Klimawandel und Waldschutz. Entsprechende Ziele wurden speziell formalisiert, um Barry Callebauts Ehrgeiz widerzuspiegeln, die Entwaldung in den Lieferketten der Rohstoffe der Gruppe zu verhindern und die CO2-Emissionen zu reduzieren:

• Bis 2025 Wald positiv sein

• Bis 2030 werden wir unseren Fußabdruck im Einklang mit den globalen Bemühungen zur Begrenzung der globalen Erwärmung auf 1,5 Grad Celsius dekarbonisiert haben.

• Bis 2050 werden wir ein Netto-Null-Unternehmen sein

Die Strategie von Barry Callebaut zur Erreichung der oben genannten „Forest Positive-Ziele und zur Einhaltung der bevorstehenden Entwaldungsverordnung der Europäischen Union (EUDR) umfasst eine Reihe von Instrumenten zur Erfüllung der Sorgfaltspflichten von BC sowie der Waldschutzziele. Mit diesen Tools und Programmen kann die Gruppe behaupten, dass die ab 2025 in Europa importierten Mengen „entwaldungsfrei und EUDR-konform sind. Diese Rolle stellt sicher, dass Barry Callebaut über erstklassige Entwaldungsüberwachungs- und Geoinformationsfunktionen verfügt, um eine konforme, entwaldungsfreie und legale Beschaffung sowie ein proaktives Risikomanagement zu unterstützen. In diesem Rahmen wird der Forest Risk & Monitoring Manager die Governance, die Leistung und die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Instrumente und Verfahren zur Überwachung der Entwaldung überwachen.

La stratégie Barry Callebauts « Forever Chocolate » comprend des engagements fermes envers le changement climatique et la protection des forêts. Des objectifs correspondants ont été spécifiquement officialisés pour refléter l'ambition de Barry Callebaut d'empêcher la déforestation dans les chaînes d'approvisionnement du Groupe des matières premières et de réduire les émissions de carbone:

• D'ici à 2025, être favorable à la forêt

• D'ici 2030, nous aurons décarboné notre empreinte en fonction des efforts déployés à l'échelle mondiale pour maîtriser le réchauffement climatique à 1,5 degré Celsius

• D'ici 2050, nous serons une entreprise zéro

La stratégie de Barry Callebaut pour atteindre les objectifs mentionnés ci-dessus et se conformer au prochain règlement de l'Union européenne sur le déboisement (RDUE) comprend un ensemble d'outils pour remplir les obligations de diligence raisonnable de BC, ainsi que les objectifs de protection des forêts. Ces outils et programmes permettront au Groupe de réclamer des volumes importés en Europe à partir de 2025 sont exempts de déforestation et conformes aux normes EUDR. descriptionByLocale.en:
About the Role

We are looking for a Cocoa GCA Pricing & Position Manager to join our team in Zürich. In this role, you will be at the center of Barry Callebaut’s global cocoa business, leading the execution of position management, risk exposure monitoring and cocoa pricing for strategic Global Corporate Account (GCA) agreements.

You will combine strong analytical capabilities with commercial acumen to translate complex market movements, position exposures and customer requirements into actionable decisions. Working closely with Trading, Risk Management, Sales, Finance, Operations and regional pricing teams, you will ensure accurate position tracking, effective hedging, robust contract execution and competitive pricing strategies.

As the owner of key position management activities, you will oversee global cocoa exposures, support hedging execution and contribute to risk optimization across regions and systems. At the same time, you will act as a trusted partner to customers and internal stakeholders, helping to develop pricing solutions, manage commercial agreements and support strategic business decisions.

You will gain deep visibility into Barry Callebaut’s global cocoa network (from origin sourcing to customer delivery) and develop a strong understanding of global cocoa flows, supply chain dynamics and market interdependencies. Your insights will help strengthen the connection between our Cocoa and Chocolate businesses by providing market intelligence that supports commercial and pricing decisions across the value chain.

Beyond day-to-day execution, you will have the opportunity to contribute to global projects, process improvements and digitalization initiatives that enhance transparency, efficiency and decision-making across the business.

Key Responsibilities include

• Lead the execution and monitoring of global cocoa positions, ensuring accurate exposure management, position reconciliation and alignment with hedging and risk management strategies.

• Own end-to-end position management activities, including volume consolidation, position calculations, synthetic exposure management, terminal market hedging and internal risk transfers.

• Monitor and analyze market exposures, financial impacts and risk positions, providing actionable insights to Trading, Risk Management and commercial teams.

• Execute cocoa pricing activities for Global Corporate Account agreements, ensuring accurate, timely and compliant contract implementation.

• Act as a central partner for customers and internal stakeholders by aligning on pricing strategies, position impacts and commercial execution requirements.

• Manage contract portfolios across assigned customers, including bookings, amendments, extensions, balance reconciliations, intercompany contracts and terminal market adjustments.

• Support daily hedging activities and ensure all relevant risk components are accurately reflected across systems, contracts and reporting tools.

• Drive market quotations and ad-hoc pricing requests, supporting sales teams with competitive, commercially sound and risk-aligned proposals.

• Develop pricing solutions for new products, customer agreements, certifications, origins and supply flows while ensuring commercial viability and effective risk management.

• Analyze forecasted, contracted and delivered volumes to support forecasting, budgeting, demand planning and commercial decision-making.

• Build strong customer relationships through regular engagement, acting as a key contact for pricing, contract execution and market-related discussions.

• Drive continuous process improvement by enhancing reporting, increasing transparency, strengthening controls and supporting automation initiatives.

• Contribute to global projects related to cost optimization, flow optimization, contingency planning, supply chain efficiency and business performance improvement.

About You

• 5+ years of experience in commodity trading, position management, pricing, sales or risk management.

• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret complex market, position and financial data and translate it into meaningful business insights.

• Solid understanding of hedging principles, futures markets and commodity risk management.

• Commercially minded with the ability to balance market dynamics, customer needs and business objectives.

• Comfortable working independently while also being a collaborative team player in a global environment.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage.

• Experience building effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders across functions and regions.

• Cocoa market expertise, including futures markets, bean origins, cocoa products and pricing mechanisms, is highly valued.

• Good understanding of supply chain and logistics, including Incoterms, contract structures and global cocoa flows.

• Experience with SAP, BW and data analysis tools is an advantage.

• Curious, proactive and continuously looking for opportunities to improve processes, increase transparency and create value through data-driven decision-making.
